description: Lossless editing JSON contract for com3d2.phy.

ColliderFileName.description: The lower-case base name of the .col resource associated with this physics file.
ColliderFileName.title: Collider resource name
ColliderFileName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep it aligned with the deployed .col file name.
ColliderFileName.x-meido-game-usage: DynamicBone records it while loading the collider list and uses it as the current collider reference.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

Damping.description: The global damping scalar before optional curve or partial-bone overrides.
Damping.title: Base damping
Damping.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep values in the source game's expected range and edit the matching EnablePartial and curve fields together.
Damping.x-meido-game-usage: The solver uses it to reduce particle motion; the distribution curve multiplies or varies it along the chain.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

Elasticity.description: The global elasticity scalar for restoring particle positions.
Elasticity.title: Base elasticity
Elasticity.x-meido-edit-guidance: Adjust with its distribution and partial mode as one group.
Elasticity.x-meido-game-usage: DynamicBone applies it during particle integration, optionally using a distribution curve.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

EndLength.description: The length of a generated terminal particle when the chain has no child.
EndLength.title: Virtual end length
EndLength.x-meido-edit-guidance: Treat EndLength and EndOffset as an either/or terminal strategy.
EndLength.x-meido-game-usage: A positive value creates a virtual end in the bone direction; EndOffset is the alternate explicit offset.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

Force.description: A constant force added to particle integration.
Force.title: External force vector
Force.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep the magnitude modest; large values can cause tunneling or explosive motion.
Force.x-meido-game-usage: Unlike gravity, it is not used to preserve an initial gravity direction.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

FreezeAxis.description: The axis constraint enum used when projecting particle motion.
FreezeAxis.title: Freeze axis
FreezeAxis.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use only 0..3 and remember that the axes are local to each parent transform.
FreezeAxis.x-meido-game-usage: The solver supports None=0, X=1, Y=2, and Z=3 in the parent-bone local frame.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

Gravity.description: The gravity vector applied to the chain.
Gravity.title: Gravity vector
Gravity.x-meido-edit-guidance: Edit all three components together and verify stability at the target scale.
Gravity.x-meido-game-usage: DynamicBone adds it to particle integration after transforming it into the simulation context.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

Inert.description: The global inertia scalar controlling how much particles follow parent motion.
Inert.title: Base inertia
Inert.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep it coherent with EnablePartialInert and PartialInert.
Inert.x-meido-game-usage: DynamicBone applies it during integration and can replace it with partial per-bone values.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

Radius.description: The base collision radius used by the particle solver.
Radius.title: Particle radius
Radius.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use non-negative values and validate against the target model scale.
Radius.x-meido-game-usage: It expands the effective particle volume before collider correction.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The physics writer and reader serialize root, partial-bone modes, base values, AnimationCurves, end behavior, gravity, force, collider references, exclusions, and freeze axis.

RootName.description: The transform name at which the dynamic particle chain starts.
RootName.title: Simulation root bone
RootName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use a bone that exists on the target body and keep its case as stored by the game.
RootName.x-meido-game-usage: DynamicBone resolves this root before creating particles and applying the parameters.

Signature.title: Physics signature
Signature.x-meido-game-usage: DynamicBone validates it before applying the settings.

Stiffness.description: The global stiffness scalar controlling resistance to bending.
Stiffness.title: Base stiffness
Stiffness.x-meido-edit-guidance: Change incrementally and test at multiple animation speeds.
Stiffness.x-meido-game-usage: The solver uses it to retain the initial bone-chain shape.

Version.description: The build-specific integer passed to curve and collider readers.

Version.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve an existing value; use the target game's value for new files.
Version.x-meido-game-usage: The game writes 24800 in the reviewed build; older files may contain another build number.
